status: Exploratory screen fixed after reading prior and inspecting file headers, before downloading or evaluating prediction rows.
question: When two image–text retrieval specialists are used in opposite directions, can a gold-free check for inconsistent local preferences recover useful compositional performance?

source.unit: one two-image / two-caption minimal-pair item; original photo identifies resampling and data split group

decisions: Take the first model's rankings of captions for each image, and the second model's rankings of images for each caption. The official group endpoint requires all four rankings correct. A directed four-cycle is present if the two directional predictions imply opposite bijections: one chooses the diagonal in both cases and the other the off-diagonal in both. This check is unchanged on permuting the two captions or the two images; it requires only the chosen indices. A shared real-valued matrix cannot satisfy such a loop of inequalities with a strict edge. Revert both queries to the training-selected single model when the cycle is observed.
selection: Group all rows with identical source-image filename. Five deterministic folds SHA256('bivlc-direction-20261120:' + filename) mod 5. On other folds rank singles by official group score, ties by file order. Compare that held-out single to (1) aggregate-best model per direction, with and without veto, and (2) all 16 direction pairs evaluated on training data with the same veto and same selected fallback. For (2), maximize four-comparison group score, then prefer a single model, then lexicographic model indices. Primary is (2) minus the training-selected single. No captions, edit labels, photo provenance, gold group pairing, or test outcome used for routing; scorer may decode released correctness bits into concrete predicted indices. These ranking files do not contain score magnitudes.
decision: Retain as an empirical candidate only with primary gain >=2 percentage points, positive paired 95% image-cluster percentile bootstrap lower bound and positive gain on at least two edit types. 5000 replicates seed 20261120, treating learned fold policies as fixed. Otherwise close rule on this benchmark and assess residual headroom via two descriptive ceilings: any already-correct single vs any directional recombination. Report incidence across all nonidentical pairings, ratio of veto rejections rescued, and positive/negative paired discordances. If training selects the same model for both directions, explicitly record zero incremental effect. Same-image/near-duplicate risk, four related CLIP variants, human–synthetic source cues, single fixed test bank and cached inference cost limit generalization. No original protected dataset images or captions republished.
